title: Connecting Banner Disappears on Open
description: For the brief moment before the live WebSocket handshake completes, the page is honest about it — a visible banner says "Connecting to live updates…". The moment the connection is actually open, that banner needs to be gone, not lingering as a stale warning.
successCondition: On first loading /tracking, a role="status" banner reading "Connecting to live updates…" is briefly visible (connectionStatus starts "connecting"), and the page header's action area shows a disabled button reading "Connecting…"; once the WebSocket's {"type": "connected"} message is received (connectionStatus becomes "open"), both the banner and the header button disappear entirely — verified by observing both elements transition from present to absent within a few seconds of page load, not just checking the final settled state.
hints: This transition can be fast in local dev — poll frequently right after navigation rather than waiting a fixed delay before your first check, or you may miss the "connecting" state entirely.
Both the banner and the header's disabled button key off the exact same connectionStatus value — a bug that clears one but not the other would be a real inconsistency to flag.
